name: Yamete! Onee-chan!! Shiroi Oshikko ga Dechau!!
original_name: やめて！ お姉ちゃん！！ 白いオシッコがでちゃう！！
source:
Yuu, the younger brother, and Miu, the older sister:
Miu showered her brother with so much affection, her love overflowing and bountiful. However, their parents became concerned with her constant doting.
Thus, the only solution was to send Miu away to prevent any misfortunes. And so, her life as a boarding student began.
The ever-so close sibling bond was broken.

Years went by with no communication between them whatsoever, but Miu finally returned home, having at long last graduated from the boarding school. 
Yuu, upon her return, was instantly captivated by her beauty, her body growing only more splendid with every passing year. 
Nonetheless, her attitude took a complete shift. The former loving and caring older sister was now cold and distant.

As fate would have it, Miu, in all actuality, hadn't changed one bit. 
The star-crossed siblings, reunited under the same roof, were separated no more.
With their parents around, Miu was forced to put up a wall between Yuu and herself, barricading her true emotions. However, whenever their parents left, Miu's change in personality was instantaneous.

Unfortunately, Yuu was cautious. He wanted to make amends. To this day, he still blames himself for his sister's sudden and forced transfer to the boarding school. His desire to rekindle their former relationship was heavily outweighed by his immense guilt.
With each passing day, Miu's desire for her younger brother grew and she became impatient. Backed into a corner, her final resort was to lure her younger brother with her feminine charms. 
Eyes at the ready, she carefully observed her prey, eager to pounce when her younger brother could no longer suppress his sexual urges.

And thus, the two siblings would spend their days enraptured in the husky aroma of sex and love...


[Translated from the description from [url=https://www.dmm.co.jp/dc/doujin/-/detail/=/cid=d_163649/]DMM[/url]]
translation:
弟弟Yuu和姐姐Miu：
Miu对哥哥倾注了太多的感情，她的爱溢满而丰富。然而，他们的父母对她不断的溺爱感到担忧。
所以，唯一的办法就是把Miu送走，免得发生任何不幸。就这样，她的寄宿生生活开始了。
曾经那么亲密的兄弟情谊被打破了。

几年过去了，他们之间没有任何联系，但美宇终于从寄宿学校毕业了，终于回到了家。
悠一回来，立刻就被她的美貌迷住了，她的身材一年比一年美丽。
尽管如此，她的态度却发生了彻底的转变。昔日慈爱贴心的姐姐，如今变得冷漠疏远。

命中注定，美宇其实一点也没有改变。
命运多舛的兄妹，重聚在同一屋檐下，不再分离。
父母在身边，Miu被迫在自己和Yuu之间筑起了一堵墙，阻挡了她真实的情感。然而，每当父母离开，Miu的性格就瞬间发生了变化。

不幸的是，Yu很谨慎。他想要弥补。直到今天，他仍然为妹妹突然被强行转学到寄宿学校而自责。他想要重新点燃他们以前的关系的愿望被他巨大的内疚所抵消。
日子一天天过去，Miu对弟弟的渴望与日俱增，她变得不耐烦了。走投无路的她最后的手段，就是用自己的女性魅力来引诱弟弟。
她的眼睛做好了准备，仔细地观察着她的猎物，当她的弟弟再也无法抑制他的性冲动时，她急于发起猛扑。

就这样，两兄妹就在性与爱的沙哑香气中度过了心醉神迷的日子……
